article_title: Knowledge of Pressure Ulcers Amongst Nurses and Associated Factors: A Cross-Sectional Study.
citation: Kocaslan Toran Meryem, Özgür Su, Aslan Fatma Eti, Toygar İsmail (2026). Knowledge of Pressure Ulcers Amongst Nurses and Associated Factors: A Cross‐Sectional Study. International Wound Journal. https://doi.org/10.1111/iwj.70888
title: Pieper–Zulkowski Pressure Injury Knowledge Test (PZ-PIKT), 2021 updated version
description: The PZ-PIKT is a 72-item knowledge test for nurses developed by Pieper and Zulkowski, originally in 2014 and updated in 2021. It is divided into three domains: prevention (31 items), staging (21 items) and wound description (20 items), with 'true', 'false' and 'do not know' response options; correct responses are scored 0 to 72 and blank or unanswered items count as incorrect. The Turkish validation study reported internal consistency of Cronbach's α = 0.80. This study used the instrument with permission from the developers.
requirements: Permission to use the instrument must be obtained from the developers, Barbara Pieper and Karen Zulkowski.
target_learners: Registered nurses and other clinical nursing staff
target_learning_goals: Assessing knowledge of pressure injury prevention, staging and wound description
examples: The study administered the test online via Google Forms alongside an eight-item nurse identification form between December 2023 and February 2025.
